title: Customer Skips and the Pharmacy Delivery Interval under Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Care academy training note — skips on a prescription Autoship**

**Q. What do customer-requested skips do to the dosing days between shipments of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship?**
A. They lengthen them. Two or more skips the customer requested on the subscription in the last twelve months add 21 days; exactly one adds 14 days; none adds no days.

**Q. Which skips count?**
A. Only skips the customer requested on that subscription. Skips booked automatically for a backorder do not count.

**Q. Which period?**
A. The last twelve months. A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Customer-requested skips on the subscription in the last twelve months | Days added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 21 |
| exactly 1 | 14 |
| none | none |

**Q. Example?**
A. Hypothetically: one customer skip five months ago, one backorder skip two months ago: one customer skip counts, 14 days are added.
